description.value: Elkford Public Library is the community library serving Elkford, a small and remote municipality in the Kootenay Rockies near the headwaters of the Elk River. It provides public computers, digitization services, printing and scanning, and a broad range of community programs. For a touring cyclist riding through this isolated valley, it stands as one of the few publicly accessible indoor facilities in town.
